definitions: A severe and potentially fatal heat illness characterized by a body temperature of 104°F (40°C) or higher, along with central nervous system dysfunction (e.g., delirium, seizures, coma).
A medical emergency resulting from prolonged exposure to high temperatures, leading to the body's inability to regulate its own temperature.
examples: He suffered from heat stroke after working in the sun all day.
Heat stroke is a serious condition.
Symptoms of heat stroke include confusion and dizziness.
